flow_summary: The interviewer moved through sections in a logical order and correctly asked repeatable items (meds, allergies) with "any other" prompts, but repeatedly accepted vague or confused answers from the disorganised patient without recovery. Gender preference, doctor's name, and DOB format confusion were left unresolved; several format-repetition requests did not help the patient and were abandoned. PHQ-9/GAD-7 items were asked cleanly once each with no safety flag needed.
